failures.criterion: Spec item 2: a process whose signing key set the fleet does not share must not serve in a multi-process deployment (the registry's refusal, processes.Register)
failures.evidence: A process whose heartbeat lapses past processes.LiveWindow (15 s) because it is frozen or cut from the database drops out of Live. A process with a key set that does not overlap then registers. When the first process resumes, Registration.beat makes its row live again and checks no key set, so both serve and each refuses the other's cookies. Observed on the real binaries at 0b7f2af5: KX SIGSTOPped 17 s, KY started (200), SIGCONT, both 200 20 s later and both rows live; the same with KX behind a TCP proxy cut 17 s. Red test (tester commit on legion/INFRA-555): TestAProcessThatResumesBesideAPeerWhoseKeySetItDoesNotShareDoesNotServeBesideIt in packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch/multiprocess_test.go, with the OwnProcessGroup option it needs added to dispatchOptions in shutdown_test.go. It asserts only that the pair does not stay serving side by side: either one exits or stops answering /healthz 200. Command: cd packages/envoy && DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<postgres url> go test -tags multiprocess -count=1 -v -run TestAProcessThatResumesBesideAPeerWhoseKeySetItDoesNotShareDoesNotServeBesideIt ./cmd/dispatch -> FAIL (45.84s) at multiprocess_test.go:1398. Under gVisor, run it in its own session (setsid). Without OwnProcessGroup, a SIGSTOPped child in the test's process group got the whole group a SIGHUP.

residualRisks: The state cookie can be replayed for its 10 minutes. Only the issuer's single-use code stops a second callback (observed: replay answered 502 invalid_grant). This matches the plan's design 2 single-use argument.
A request whose confirmation has lapsed waits for the refresh timeout (about 15 s observed) while the issuer does not answer, and only then answers 503.

A registry row pruned after 10 minutes without a heartbeat is never written again (beat logs an ERROR every 5 s). That process then serves outside the key check and outside the announcer's view until it restarts.
